snippet.title: Octillery Vs Xi Jinping Playthrough (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
An RPG made in RPG Maker 2003 with web support by The EasyRPG Team.

See familiar faces, such as Octillery, John Xina, The Wock, and Marill The Hedgehog.

It was just a normal day in China... Until Octillery, John Xina, and The Wock suddenly decided to finally rebel against Xi!

You'll have to fight and protest against p.a.p officers and tanks and take down XinniePooh once and for all...

there are also alot of secrets, one being more important than you'd expect...

Original Newgrounds Release: https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/830333

Itch.io Release: https://joeythemarillfan.itch.io/octillery-vs-xi-jinping

https://gamejolt.com/games/octillery_xijinping/706392
